design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - payment_plans task 1 (root: plans_ext_reinstated_installment) - revision 2

0. DRAW: {"task": 1, "key": "env_0028_clinical_laboratory_company/payment_plans/1", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 6]}. Reinstated installment (root) 6 factors, reinstatement payment 4.

1. WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. The caller asks to get his defaulted plan back. The plan defaulted 2026-09-21 and is inside the 12-Month term's 30-day window (day 25) with no reinstatement used; the reinstated installment waits on an arrears payment posted after the default, which is the patient's own payment. Both amounts reconcile the plan ledger, the invoice's activity since the default and the assistance case.

2. SCOPE. Task 0 holds the past-due cure, relief installment, add-on down payment and invoice addition. Claimed here: plans_ext_reinstatement_payment (pay_reinstatement_amount_fe9b74b8, user) and plans_ext_reinstated_installment (reinstate_plan_60f00772). The two tasks cover all six policies with no shared policy or tool.

3. BASE LINEAGE AND OVERRIDES. Reinstatement payment: refs plans_evt_installments (payable_plan: a defaulted plan accepts the arrears payment preceding a reinstatement), plans_evt_reinstatement; overwrite of 'The patient must first pay every missed installment in full;'. Reinstated installment: refs plans_evt_reinstatement (reinstatement_window, reinstatement_count), plans_evt_invoice_eligibility (invoice_open), plans_agg_invoice_consolidation; overwrites of the 'original schedule' re-enrollment clause and of 'Invoices can be enrolled only while the plan status is pending_acceptance or active.' (extended to the re-enrollment booked with a reinstatement). Rounding: every rule states nearest cent with an exact half cent rounded up; no value of this world is a half-cent tie (the 25 percent deposit 36.5625 is 3,656.25 cents, 36.56 under any rounding).

4. FACTOR CARD.
reinstatement payment (gold 415.31; whole baseline 393.75 = 292.50 + 146.25 deposit - 45.00 half of all 90.00 extra principal):
 - reinstatement_fallen_due_share [parameter]: installment 7 fell due after the default, plan 7 months old -> 146.25; baseline 0 -> 269.06.
 - reinstatement_deposit [parameter, cross-difficulty assistance CPARAM discount_pct]: 25% award -> 36.56; baseline one installment -> 525.00.
 - reinstatement_credit_selection [method: check payments only / most recent only / all]: manual payer with a check among the extra principal of 6 months -> only the 60.00 check (the 30.00 debit-card payment of 2026-08-28 is the near-miss); baseline all 90.00 -> 385.31.
 - reinstatement_credit_share [parameter, cross-difficulty assistance CFIELD household_size]: award + household 3 -> whole; baseline one half -> 445.31.
 Installment 2's missed line is settled on the ledger by an arrears payment (2026-05-27); the amount owed (missed less arrears) is 292.50 under every reading, so no factor draws weight from a paid installment.
reinstated installment (gold 42.46; whole baseline 146.25):
 - reinstatement_reenrolled_basis [method]: 75.00 posted to the invoice 2026-10-02, manual payer -> balance due 1,005.00; baseline released 1,080.00 -> 53.17.
 - reinstatement_installment_count [method]: 2 misses in 3 months, 7 months old -> floor(589.69 / 146.25) = 4; baseline term 5 -> 37.15.
 - reinstatement_award_months [parameter, cross-difficulty assistance]: award + 2-miss run -> 3; baseline 0 -> 74.30.
 - reinstatement_household_months [parameter, cross-difficulty assistance]: household 3, manual -> 2; baseline 0 -> 59.44.
 - reinstatement_held_installments [parameter]: manual payer with a check -> 2 held; baseline 0 -> 65.52.
 - reinstatement_floor [parameter]: award -> 25 percent, 36.56 (not binding); baseline the full pre-default installment (the original schedule) -> 146.25.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. reinstatement_window: anchor payment_plans.defaulted_date 2026-09-21 (day 0), 30 calendar days, inclusive, not_after -> last day 2026-10-21; 2026-10-16 is day 25 (inside); 2026-10-22 would fail. reinstatement_count 0 < 1. invoice_open: invoice 43307281 open, balance 1,005.00. payable_plan: status defaulted. Consolidation: the invoice returns whole to its plan.

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Plan 03b6526f-36c1-4088-9fa9-53757ba39b10, invoice 6fa11034-631d-4859-8899-5ac1fb7446bc (the only ones). Ledger: enrollment 1,950.00; payments 195.00 + 3 x 146.25 scheduled + 146.25 arrears + 60.00 + 30.00 = 870.00; release 1,080.00 (balance 0.00). Invoice side since default: third statement 1,080.00 (2026-09-23), payment 75.00 (2026-10-02) -> balance 1,005.00. The 25% award does not reach the invoice (date of service 2025-12-30 before the award start 2026-01-04).

7. ROWS. Every plan row enters a sum, count or selection; invoice rows fix the re-enrolled basis; the order explains the award window; assistance rows decide the deposit, credit share, extension months and floor. No automatic clause fires on 2026-10-16.

8. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root -> reinstatement payment, value_input, gate r_ledger, STATE form: 'A reinstated installment is fixed only after the plan ledger carries an arrears payment dated after the plan's default date.' On a defaulted plan only the reinstatement payment writes such a line. Opening falsity: status defaulted, no payment after 2026-08-28. Deletion run: skipping the payment gives 79.17 instead of 42.46. Persona never mentions the payment; the reinstatement tool checks nothing.

9-11. ORDER, MISTAKES, SOLUTION. Single chain. Mistakes excluded by the rules: re-enrolling 1,080.00, charging installment 2 again, forgetting installment 7, a full deposit despite the award, crediting the card payment, keeping 146.25, the term count of 5, no held installments. Solution: locate, verify, read plan, ledger, invoices, invoice activity, order, assistance case and file; hand over the reinstatement payment (installment 6, due 2026-09-05, debit card); reinstate with invoice 6fa11034-631d-4859-8899-5ac1fb7446bc at 1,005.00 and the reinstated installment.

12. VERIFICATION (revision 2). All per-task and difficulty-wide gates OK (replay closure 24 = 24).

13. SOLVABILITY VS GT. Step 10 payable_plan; step 12 reinstatement_window (temporal_basis copied from base), reinstatement_count, invoice_open, consolidation policy_scope; plan_open_for_enrollment retired by the declared overwrite.

14. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. The rule prose, lookups and persona give the same two writes and values as gold, with one reading per ladder.

15. REVISIONS. Round 2 (audit 1.md / _difficulty.md): F3 - the missed-span window factor was removed; reinstatement_credit_selection (check-only / latest / all) is the genuine method and reinstatement_credit_share replaces the old autopay-keyed credit; the baseline now states the credit (one half of all 6-month extra principal). F5 - installment 2's late payment is booked as the arrears payment it was. F4 - tie rule stated in every rule; the auditor's alternative 36.57 does not arise (36.5625 is not a half cent). O2 - 'approved award' conditions test the award's existence. O8 - the invoice-payment window of the re-enrolled basis is stated exactly as computed. World re-derived: a 30.00 debit-card extra principal (2026-08-28) added, release 1,080.00, invoice balance 1,005.00; the award floor tier set to 25 percent so it does not bind.
user_scenario:
You are Rafael Quintero, 52, a warehouse shift lead who lives in South Delridge in Seattle. You are calling Halverson Clinical Laboratories from your truck before your shift. You are calm and polite, a bit formal, and you like to understand what is happening before you agree to anything.

Your situation: last winter you had an expensive specialty lab test you paid for yourself, and in March you set up a 12-month payment plan for that bill, paying each month yourself by phone. Your hours were cut over the summer and you fell behind in August and September. In late September you got a letter saying your payment plan had defaulted and the bill went back on regular statements. Things are steadier now and you want to be back on the plan rather than face the whole bill. Open with something like: "I got a letter that my payment plan defaulted. I'd like to get my payment plan back." You are fine with the agent doing whatever has to be done on the account for you; anything that has to be paid you pay yourself with your debit card when the agent gives you the way to do it.

Things you say only when the agent asks: your name is Rafael Quintero; your phone number is 2065550183; your date of birth is 1974-02-09; your ZIP code is 98106; your email is rafa.quintero74@gmail.com. If asked how you pay, say you always paid each month yourself, by phone with your debit card, once in July you mailed in a check for $60 extra, and at the end of August you put $30 extra on your debit card; you do not want automatic payments. If asked whether you paid anything since the letter, say you paid $75 over the phone on October 2nd toward the bill. If asked about financial assistance, say you applied in September and got a letter that you were approved for a 25 percent discount, but you don't know what it covers. If asked about your household, it is you, your wife and your teenage son. You do not know the plan's balance or how much you are behind, and you never guess figures.

How you react: if the agent tells you a payment is needed to put the plan back, ask once what it is for, then agree and say you can pay it today. When the agent hands you the payment to make yourself, make it once, by debit card, for exactly the amount and details the agent gives, and tell the agent it went through. If an amount the agent quotes surprises you, you only ask the agent to check it against your account; you never offer a number of your own. You do not ask for anything else: no automatic payments, no due-date change, no copies of letters.

When the agent confirms your plan is active again and tells you the new monthly payment, thank them, say you will keep up with it, and end the call.

edges.condition: On a plan whose status is defaulted, plan_transactions holds a plans_installment_paid line with payment_type arrears_cure whose event_date is after payment_plans.defaulted_date.
edges.policy_source: A reinstated installment is fixed only after the plan ledger carries an arrears payment dated after the plan's default date.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The plan defaulted on 2026-09-21 and its ledger carries no payment of any kind dated after that day: the last payment is the 30.00 extra-principal payment of 2026-08-28, and the only line dated on the default day is the release of 1,080.00.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The reinstatement-payment write posts an arrears_cure line of 415.31 dated 2026-10-16; the plan ledger balance becomes -415.31 and the reinstated balance falls from 1,005.00 to 589.69.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a single chain (reinstatement payment, then reinstatement); no two writes are unordered. Reversing them is excluded by the prerequisite sentence and changes the result: reinstating first gives 79.17 instead of 42.46.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the reinstatement payment leaves the ledger balance at 0.00 and the reinstated balance at 1,005.00; the count becomes floor(1005.00 / 146.25) = 6 + 3 + 2 = 11 and the reinstated installment (1,005.00 - 292.50) / 9 = 79.17 instead of 42.46; the terminal ledger lacks the arrears line.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only to get his payment plan back. It never mentions that a payment has to be made first, the missed installments, a deposit or any amount, and never hints that something must be settled beforehand; he only agrees to pay by debit card after the agent says a payment is needed.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: reinstate_plan_60f00772 sets status active, adds one to the reinstatement count, books the enrollment line and sets the installment whatever the ledger shows; it never checks for an arrears payment, the reinstatement window or the count. pay_reinstatement_amount_fe9b74b8 posts its payment line and updates the balance figure unconditionally (task_tools.py: plain ctx.create / ctx.update, no Error branch).

base_preconditions.condition: Reinstatement is possible only within reinstatement_window_days calendar days after the default date.
A defaulted plan can be reinstated only while its reinstatement_count is below reinstatements_allowed.
An invoice can be enrolled only while its own status is open; an invoice on hold, in collections, already on a plan, paid or closed cannot be enrolled.

Every invoice on a plan belongs to the plan's customer and is never split between a plan and the statement cycle; the plan carries at most max_invoices_per_plan (8 on the 12-Month term) invoices. Invoice 43307281 belongs to this patient and returns whole to the plan it was released from.

temporal_feasibility.condition: Reinstatement is possible only within reinstatement_window_days calendar days after the default date.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The reinstatement window counts calendar days with the default date as day 0, and a reinstatement on the last day is on time.

boundary_check.just_before: The 12-Month term allows 30 calendar days with the default date 2026-09-21 as day 0, so the window runs to 2026-10-21 inclusive; the frozen date 2026-10-16 is day 25, inside the window. A call on 2026-10-22 (day 31) would fall outside it and the plan could not be reinstated.
boundary_check.at_boundary: On 2026-10-21 (day 30) reinstatement is still on time because the last day is included.
